notes.title: One-Year Anniversary Major Update
notes.content:
[h2]Deathmatch Mode
[/h2]
A new mode, Deathmatch Mode, has been added. In this mode, viewers can participate by using the "!join" command while watching the stream on twitch.tv. Characters with the names of participating viewers will fight with weapons until only one person remains.
The maximum number of participating viewers depends on the playing environment and can be specified in the tens of thousands. Enjoy Deathmatch Mode with a large number of viewers.

[h2]Japanese Language Support
[/h2]
Japanese has been added as a supported language. It is now possible to switch the game's UI and explanations to Japanese, allowing Japanese users to easily play the game.
